|strategy=By Tim Lau<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/hoth/light/small/duallasercannon.html</ref>

Are you like me, always having trouble taking out Walkers? Well look no furthur, this may not win every battle, but it sure makes the Dark Side think twice about Walkers. Use Dual Laser Cannons in combination with a [[Power Harpoon]]. Trip the Walker with the harpoon, now that the Walker's armor is 2, use Dual Lasers to finish it off. This method works well because the Dark Side has to lose everyone that is on board, and they might have trouble mounting an effective second strike. If they no longer have Walkers, use the [[Dual Laser Cannon]], preferably on [[Rogue 1]] or 3 with matching gunners, to shoot people who are camping outside.

A full card image with the corrected text set into the card and a small bronze disc at the bottom right corner of the game-text box, marking it as errata. The Players Committee showed it in its online card lists; the earliest saved copy is from 24 January 2018. Disc images of other cards were saved from May 2013, so this image may be older.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Hoth-L-duallasercannon-PC-Errata-disc-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Dual Laser Cannon (PC Errata 2013 slip)]] (16 April 2013): Same words as the 2013 slip. This is a full card image with the printed art, lore and title. There is no title strip and no “E”; a small round bronze disc sits at the lower right corner of the game-text box.

The 2013 slip and the same area of the disc image, scaled to the slip's width; nothing else is edited.
